description: Source code for BasicSourceLineResolver implementation in the Google Breakpad project, handling symbol parsing, address lookup, and stack frame info.

classes.name: BasicSourceLineResolver
classes.description: Implementation of source line resolver for symbol and debug info.

classes.name: BasicSourceLineResolver::Module
classes.description: Represents a module with symbol and debug info, capable of parsing symbol data and address lookup.

methods.name: LoadMapFromMemory
methods.description: Loads symbol map data from memory buffer, parsing lines for functions, files, and symbols.

methods.name: LookupAddress
methods.description: Resolves an address to function name, source file, and line number.

methods.name: FindWindowsFrameInfo
methods.description: Retrieves Windows-specific stack frame information for a given address.

methods.name: FindCFIFrameInfo
methods.description: Retrieves CFI (Call Frame Information) rules for a given address.

methods.name: ParseFile
methods.description: Parses a FILE line in symbol data to extract file index and name.

methods.name: ParseFunction
methods.description: Parses a FUNC line to extract function address, size, stack parameters, and name.

methods.name: ParseLine
methods.description: Parses a line info line to extract address, size, line number, and source file.

methods.name: ParsePublicSymbol
methods.description: Parses a PUBLIC symbol line to extract address, stack parameters, and name.

methods.name: ParseStackInfo
methods.description: Parses stack info lines for Windows or CFI data.

methods.name: ParseCFIFrameInfo
methods.description: Parses CFI frame info lines for initial and delta rules.
